items.difficulty_reason: Abelianness lemma (statement 419-423, proof 425-437): the differential graded module category is abelian and complete/cocomplete - the proof proceeds by creation through the forgetful functor, with the mechanism (commutation of the operations) stated in the span and one concrete computation (the degree-wise product with direct-sum totalization, which is the genuinely non-obvious point); the equalizers input of the criterion is covered because kernels are equalizers. H2: standard creation argument with one explicit formula.
